synopsis:
Best Narrative Film, Austin Film Festival
OUTshine LGBTQ+ Film Festival

 

Asian Premiere

 

Thirty years abroad have not loosened the knot in Raanan's chest. Now middle-aged and guarded, he returns to the Tel Aviv of his youth, carrying the weight of an unfinished life. But the hardest borders to cross are the ones he drew inside himself decades ago, long before he ever left. When a brief and electric affair with a much younger man ignites desire, confusion and shame all at once, Raanan is sent spiralling: caught between who he was, who he pretended to be, and who he might still become.

 

Writer-director Yuval Hadadi shoots his homeland with unflinching tenderness in a quietly devastating study of internalised homophobia and the long road to making peace with oneself. Named Best Narrative Feature at the 2025 Austin Film Festival, it is a portrait of a man finally daring to walk his own path.
